svg.title: How to install and uninstall Command Center
svg.desc: Animation with captions: download and extract the zip, double-click the installer, wait for ALL DONE, use the setup wizard; to remove, double-click the uninstaller and choose whether to keep your data.
svg.text: How to install and uninstall Command Center

g.text: A Windows 11 computer, an internet connection and about 1.5 GB of free disk space
(the installer checks this first and tells you). Python is added for you if it is
The project page in your browser
On the project page, click Code, then Download ZIP. The file lands in your
Right-click the zip file and choose Extract All. Then open the new folder it
If Windows says it protected your PC, click More info, then Run anyway. The file
is short text, and you can open it in Notepad first.
ALL DONE. Command Center is running.
A black window runs five steps and takes a few minutes. Windows may ask permission
once, to add LibreOffice for PDF resumes. When it says ALL DONE, close the window.
Real screenshot of the first screen
Step 5. Your browser opens the setup wizard.
Choose Look around with demo data first to explore with made-up data, or Set up
with my own data to begin.
To remove it, double-click Uninstall Command Center.
It asks first. If the installer added LibreOffice, pipx or Python, it asks about
each of those too. Nothing is removed until you say yes.
Your data is kept unless you choose to delete it.
Deleting is permanent, so a zip copy goes to your Desktop first. To preview what
would be removed, run the uninstall script with the DryRun option.
How to install and uninstall Command Center
6. Step 5. Your browser opens the setup wizard.
7. To remove it, double-click Uninstall Command Center.
8. Your data is kept unless you choose to delete it.
